title: Coordinates of the canonical tensor-completion chain map
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a scheme W [def-pc-scheme]. Work over the completed coefficient sheaf on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], with its unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and signed total tensor of two arbitrary cochain complexes P,Q [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves, lem-fix-constructible-tensor-completion-presentation]. Compose the canonical Roos augmentation of the ordinary signed total tensor with Roos of the normalized whole-tower tensor isomorphism [def-pur-integral-derived-operations, lem-pur-integral-ambient-operation-models]. This is a natural chain map into the specified completed tensor representative. Its n-th first mapping-fiber product coordinate sends a homogeneous pure tensor x tensor y to the finite tensor of the two canonical coefficient quotient sections (n denotes exponent n+1). Its shifted mapping-fiber coordinate is zero. No boundedness, nonemptiness or constructibility hypothesis is needed.

proof.text: Use the constructed natural chain map and its normalized component equation. The map is the actual Roos augmentation followed by the actual normalized strict tensor-tower isomorphism.

Use tensorOperationUnit_coordinates for the first product coordinate. Compose its first equality with the n-th projection, use Pi.map_pi and Pi.lift_pi_assoc, then the normalization of the quotient augmentation and of tensorTowerModel on pure tensor generators. This gives exactly the two finite quotient sections in the statement. Its second coordinate is the existing zero-coordinate equation.

theorem tensorChain_first
    (P Q : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E W) ℤ) (p q : ℤ) (n : ℕ)
    (U : W.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : (P.X p).val.obj U) (y : (Q.X q).val.obj U) :
    (((((tensorCompletionChain l E W).app (P, Q)) ≫ CochainComplex.mappingCocone.fst
      (towerTransitionEndomorphism
      (K := fun n ↦ (integralOperationsTensorLevel l E W n).obj (P, Q))
      (integralOperationsTowerStep ((integralOperationsTensorTowerFunctor l E W).obj (P, Q)))) ≫
      Pi.π (fun n ↦ (integralOperationsTensorLevel l E W n).obj (P, Q)) n).f
        (p + q)).val.app U) (coefficientTensorGenerator.{u, u + 1, u} (ProEt.topology W)
        (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E W) P Q p q (p + q) rfl U x y) =
      integralOperationsTotalTensorSection l E W n P Q p q U
        (unrestrictedIntegralTensorSection l E W n (P.X p) U 1 x)
        (unrestrictedIntegralTensorSection l E W n (Q.X q) U 1 y)
